title: Sheep waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wool' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d8e4f0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <g fill='url(#wool)' stroke='#c2d3e6' stroke-width='1.2'>
    <circle cx='36' cy='64' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='14'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='64' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='11'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='74' r='11'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='76' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='57' cy='76' r='12'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='13'/>
  </g>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#4a4a5c'/>
  <rect x='54' y='84' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#4a4a5c'/>
  <rect x='39' y='92' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6e6e85'/>
  <rect x='53' y='92' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6e6e85'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='16' fill='#5a5a70'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='11' fill='#8a8aa5'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='38' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7a7a95' transform='rotate(-15 27 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='38' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7a7a95' transform='rotate(15 57 38)'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='38' r='3' fill='#20202e'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='38' r='3' fill='#20202e'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M36 46 Q42 51 48 46' stroke='#20202e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- waving arm -->
  <path d='M76 66 Q84 58 86 44' stroke='#5a5a70' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='40' r='6' fill='#7a7a95'/>

  <!-- other front leg -->
  <rect x='22' y='70' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#4a4a5c' transform='rotate(10 25 77)'/>
</svg>
